title: fix(connectNumericMenu + connectRange): stop sending invalid clickedFilters event
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!
  Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request.
-->

JIRA: [FX-1633](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1633)

**Summary**

The [Clicked Filters](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-methods/clicked-filters/) method of Insights does not support numeric filters, but the `connectNumericMenu` and `connectRange` connectors still send this event automatically when refined. This generates errors on the dashboard's events debugger (see [CR-1588](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/CR-1588)).

This PR removes this call.

**Result**

The `clickedFilters` event is not sent anymore during the lifecycle of the widget using the underlying `connectNumericMenu` and `connectRange` connectors.
